findings.text: non-blocking: the counter-rollup test compares the rollup reader against a raw reader but never forces whole-hour rows to come from hourly_rollup, so a regression that answers a whole-day counter period from raw rows keeps this assertion true and leaves the window-cost property the goal names unguarded; only the gauge half has a reddening mutation.

non-blocking: the hourly_rollup.counter_diff column is written by the ingest and asserted non-null at tests/test_agent_telemetry_watch.py:512, but no production reader selects it -- _counter_window_rows reconstructs the difference from the segments column instead, so the column and its assertion carry no behaviour.

non-blocking: the admitted red log's own '# command:' header omits AMBIX_TEST_PERTURB_ROLLUP=1, so the log is not reproducible from its header; the failure body shows the mutation branch executed and printed 'rollup mismatch at $.ledger[1].utilisation'.
